actors.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
actors.role: Senator of Brazil and defeated presidential candidate
actors.blurb: Following his loss in Brazil's presidential election to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro fled to the United States despite judicial restrictions. His presence in the U.S. has triggered diplomatic de-escalation efforts between Washington and Brasília, while legal actions in Brazil seek to suspend his salary and revoke his Senate mandate.

actors.name: Karol Nawrocki
actors.blurb: President Karol Nawrocki abruptly cut short an official visit to Senegal to return to Warsaw following the suspension of senior Constitutional Tribunal judges. Nawrocki physically entered the tribunal building during late-night confrontations and summoned urgent cross-party consultations, accusing Prime Minister Donald Tusk's government of an unconstitutional coup.

actors.name: Javier Milei
actors.blurb: President Javier Milei led the high-profile inauguration of an evangelical church auditorium in Neuquén, using the platform to champion Judeo-Christian values and zero-compromise fiscal balance. Milei also delivered a fiery speech accusing journalists of malice and politicians of corruption, while prosecutors appealed the dismissal of a financial investigation against him and his sister.

actors.name: Jimmie Åkesson
actors.blurb: Sweden Democrats leader Jimmie Åkesson intervened aggressively in an escalating internal party dispute over Swedish identity, defending civic and cultural nationalism against hardline ethnic definitions. Åkesson issued an ultimatum to party members, warning that anyone rejecting the leadership's stance must fall in line or face expulsion.
